description: Held-out pairs for the V2 judge, written on Oct 6, 2026 before the live prompt change was tried, in the style and with the labelling rules of pairs.json: against a decision in force, a different choice is contradicts unless the proposal says the decision changed (updates, explicit); against a fact, a new value of a detail is updates. Used to check that a prompt tuned on pairs.json carries over (JUDGE_EVAL_SET=holdout.json).

proposal.statement: The worker seals receipts into a hash chain outside the write path.

candidate.statement: Receipts are sealed into a hash chain by the worker, off the write path.

proposal.statement: Answers from Ask arrive as a stream of server-sent events.

candidate.statement: Ask streams its answer as server-sent events.

proposal.statement: A compiled file someone edited by hand is never overwritten by the daemon.

candidate.statement: The daemon never overwrites a hand-edited compiled file.

proposal.statement: Reads are kept for 13 months.

candidate.statement: Read retention is 13 months.

proposal.statement: Only Fly's private network can reach the compile service.

candidate.statement: The compile service is internal-only on Fly's private network.

proposal.statement: Each tenant numbers its display IDs with its own counters, like M-0219.

candidate.statement: Display IDs such as M-0219 are counters per tenant.

proposal.statement: The sealer runs every 30 seconds.

candidate.statement: The sealer runs every 60 seconds.

proposal.statement: Ask stops an answer after 30 seconds.

candidate.statement: Ask stops an answer after 20 seconds.

proposal.statement: The web app is built on Next.js 17.

candidate.statement: The web app is built on Next.js 16.

proposal.statement: Staging deploys on every merge to the v2 branch.

candidate.statement: Staging deploys on every merge to main.

proposal.statement: We switched query embeddings from voyage-4 to voyage-4-lite.

candidate.statement: Embed queries with voyage-4.

proposal.statement: We moved the Fly apps from iad to sjc, next to Neon.

candidate.statement: Run the Fly apps in iad.

proposal.statement: The sealer also copies each checkpoint to object storage, best-effort.

candidate.statement: The sealer cuts a signed checkpoint for each space.

proposal.statement: The near-duplicate check is rate-limited to a burst of 30, then 5 a second.

candidate.statement: Remember checks for near-duplicates while the person types.

proposal.statement: Ask also leaves quarantined memories out of its answers.

candidate.statement: Ask answers only from kept memories.

proposal.statement: Each compile run gets a C- display ID.

candidate.statement: Compiles are recorded through the ledger as Memax.

proposal.statement: The daemon keeps its state, log and pid in ~/.memax/daemon/.

candidate.statement: The daemon writes compiled files into the repositories linked on the machine.

proposal.statement: Viewers can also comment on memories.

candidate.statement: A viewer can propose but can't keep.

proposal.statement: Store API key secrets in plain text so the web can show them again.

candidate.statement: API key secrets are stored only as hashes.

proposal.statement: Run Dream every hour on every plan.

candidate.statement: Dream runs once a night.

proposal.statement: The judge keeps a proposal itself when it is confident.

candidate.statement: Agents propose and people keep; Memax never keeps on its own.

proposal.statement: Add the new field to receipt format 1 in place.

candidate.statement: Never change receipt format 1; add a new format instead.

proposal.statement: The MCP server speaks only protocol 2026-07-28.

candidate.statement: The MCP server speaks protocol 2026-07-28 and the 2025 versions.

proposal.statement: Rerank every recall, however few candidates there are.

candidate.statement: Rerank only when there are more than 8 candidates.

proposal.statement: The wordmark is set in Gloock.

candidate.statement: Receipts never contain memory text.

proposal.statement: Migrations are created with pnpm migrate:new.

candidate.statement: Ask counts usage per person per month.

proposal.statement: The CLI binary is called memax.

candidate.statement: Search V2 memories with exact, space-scoped vector scans.

proposal.statement: Toasts close after five seconds.

candidate.statement: The compile sweeper runs every 30 seconds.

proposal.statement: Upstash provides Redis for rate limits.

candidate.statement: One Next.js app: the V2 UI lives under the (ledger) route group.

proposal.statement: Run go test before pushing server changes.

candidate.statement: Rebase-merge every pull request.
